rationale: All four units must be committed. Demand plus reserve is 300 MW, and N-1 security requires remaining capacity after loss of the largest committed unit to also be at least 300 MW. The only subset satisfying this is {g1,g2,g3,g4}: 550 MW total, 370 MW after losing the 180 MW largest unit g3. Cost = startup (400+550+700+220) + no-load (80+100+120+60) = 2230 USD.
